stage.name: Gassur City Race
stage.description:
<Booster> Speeds up your slug for a while!
<Magnet> Allows your slug to latch on to a target and move along its direction!
<Vacuum> Your slug will continuously steal a target's stamina!
The Gassur City Race is the most chaotic part of the entire Gala. Just imagine a racetrack full of pedestrians, hawker stalls, and kids throwing fruit peels! Marvelous, isn't it?
stage.source: mode level file; no stage_table row
